text.text_excerpt: I stayed here for my wife's 30th birthday over last weekend. It was her first time to New Orleans, my 2nd time there. This was also the 2nd time staying at the Westin for me. This hotel is very nice, it sits up on top of a upscale shopping mall. The lobby is actually on the 11th floor, it has a awesome view of the Mississippi River right in the lobby. It's a real cool thing. They have rooms that have views of the river also. Rooms are spacious, have a safe in them to store your valuables, decent beds, and standard bathroom. TV are pretty 2008 though. Need to upgrade those. We didn't check out the bar or restaurant but will next time we stay here.

Stayed in the Westin for a weekend a little while back, went really well. It's a great location, super close to, but importantly, not deep in the French Quater so you can easily get to the action but stay a little outside of it. The lobby is on the 6th or 7th floor making it a great spot to sit and enjoy the view over the Mississippi. Our room didn't have quite so good a view but the room itself was fine. Bed and pillows were super comfortable, large TV..all pretty standard but nice all the same. I had a great stay at the Westin Canal Place...sure, the hotel needs some improvement but, I cant really complain. For starters, the hotel begins on the 11th floor of a 30 floor building. You can almost guarantee that almost every room in this hotel will have a pretty nice view. The downside to this...the hotel is above a high-end shopping mall. So for all you shoppers out there, this is the place to be (Saks Fifth Ave, Tiffanys....ugh). Luckily, me and my colleague were booked in a 2 bedroom Governor Suite.
